mapper.select: select id, user_id, name, dir_id as parent_id, del_flag from note_notes where id = #{id} for update
select id, user_id, name, pid as parent_id, del_flag from note_directory where id = #{id} for update
select id, user_id, name, pid as parent_id, del_flag from note_directory where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'
select id, user_id, name, pid as parent_id, del_flag from note_directory where user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.delete: delete from note_notes where id = #{id} and trash_id = #{trashId} and user_id = #{userId}
delete from note_notes where trash_id = #{trashId} and user_id = #{userId}
delete from note_directory where trash_id = #{trashId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select id from note_trash where user_id = #{userId} order by deleted_time desc, id desc
select id from note_trash order by deleted_time desc, id desc

select t.id, t.user_id, t.object_type, t.object_id, t.name, t.original_parent_id, t.original_path, t.note_count, t.dir_count, t.create_by, t.deleted_time, t.expire_time from note_trash t left join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.user_id
and t.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and t.object_type = #{objectType}
and u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%')
order by t.deleted_time desc, t.id desc
